en: A vintage black‑and‑white (sepia‑toned) postcard showing a panoramic view over a dense townscape with many multi‑story houses, factory chimneys and an arched iron bridge in the foreground. The image looks across rooftops toward an industrial horizon. Printed German text in red at the top identifies the view, and red vertical text is printed along the left border with a publisher's line and a number.
